what_works: A single geometric concept (Bauhaus-derived clock) carries the entire page — no scroll-noise, no testimonials, just the idea executed with discipline. Primary-color-only palette enforced with Bauhaus rigor.
what_does_not_translate: Single-concept-as-entire-page works for a product, not a service business; the rigor (primary colors only, geometric type, no decoration) is what transfers as a discipline check.
type_observations: Geometric sans (Futura/Avenir lineage) in heavy weight; pure typographic statement, no body-text rescue.
